snippet.title: Emberville | "Thank You" Trailer
snippet.description:
The positive response to Emberville so far has been a lot to take in. 

Seriously, thank you all!

However, not everyone on the team is being humble about this success. Especially not the voice cast.

Enjoy a brand new video as revealed in the FGS at GDC event!

🔗 Wishlist EMBERVILLE on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2295170/Emberville

Join the Discord: https://Discord.gg/Emberville
Follow us on X: https://x.com/EmbervilleGame
